note: The citing work (a Raw microprocessor evaluation paper sharing authors Lee, Frank, and Amarasinghe) explicitly evaluates the Raw machine including its ILP compiler, which is the direct subject of the cited ASPLOS 1998 paper on space-time scheduling for Raw; the cited work is a foundational piece of the Raw research lineage being evaluated here.
title: Evaluation of the raw microprocessor: an exposed-wire-delay architecture for ILP and streams
